notes.title: Important information. Date of release.
notes.notes:
Due to unforeseen circumstances, we will not be able to release the game in December, as stated in the game trailer. The output is planned for January 1, 2018.
This is the nearest possible date,  however not exact [/ u].
We apologize to the whole community.
